title: Tools and Tool Calling with LangChain
learning_objectives: Define tools with the @tool decorator, a docstring and type hints
Read tool calls from an AIMessage and answer them with ToolMessages
Turn tool errors into messages the model can read instead of crashes
hints: Put `@tool` on a normal function with type hints and a one-line docstring.
Build `by_name = {t.name: t for t in tools}` and loop over `message.tool_calls`.
Wrap `by_name[name].invoke(call["args"])` in try/except Exception and always pass `tool_call_id=call["id"]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Decorate the functions with @tool and give them the exact docstrings.
Return one ToolMessage per call with content=str(result) and tool_call_id=call['id'].
Unknown tools become error ToolMessages, not exceptions.
Catch exceptions from tool.invoke and report them with status='error'.
